company.name: besimple AI
company.shortDescription: besimple AI provides custom human-interaction data and benchmarks for training and evaluating voice AI systems.
company.description: Besimple AI builds the data and evaluation layer for voice AI. Besimple AI collects, licenses, annotates, and evaluates real human-interaction data across languages, accents, domains, and recording conditions. Its public benchmarks, including VoiceCodeBench and VocalAffectBench, measure production-critical failures such as structured-token recovery and vocal-affect understanding. Besimple AI works with leading AI labs to source custom and ready-to-use datasets, evaluate models, and improve real-world performance for voice AI.
